name: tombstone-card
description: Placeholder card for archived, closed or unavailable marketplace items.
designIntent: Removing unavailable items silently breaks saved links and user expectations. TombstoneCard keeps the item in place and states the reason and status.

examples.title: Archived listing
examples.code:
<TombstoneCard
  title="Archived listing"
  reason="This listing closed in 2025."
  status="archived"
  href="/deals/archived"
/>
examples.description: A muted card that explains why the listing is unavailable.

antiPatterns.title: Don't remove the item without explanation
antiPatterns.explanation: A saved link or bookmark should still resolve to a card that explains the state.

accessibility.implementation: The unavailable state is a text badge, not color alone

compositionRules.relationship: Use in place of a DealCard or EntityCard when the item is unavailable
